# Star Wars App

> An interactive web application consuming structured Star Wars data from the public SWAPI (Star Wars API) and pairing each entity with visual assets provided by the companion project Star Wars Gallery.

## Overview
- Website: https://star-warsapp.netlify.app/
- Source Code: https://github.com/SergioCoitino/StarWars-App
- Author: Sergio Coitiño (https://sergio-coitino.netlify.app/)
- Architecture: React Single Page Application (SPA), React Router, Responsive CSS

## Key Features
- Dynamic browsing of SWAPI resources: Characters, Starships, Planets, Vehicles, Species.
- Paginated data fetching with automatic timeout and fallback API failover (swapi.dev -> swapi.py4e.com).
- 1:1 ID extraction from canonical SWAPI URLs to guarantee visual asset consistency.
- Interactive modal view for deep-dive stats and physical traits.

## Companion Project & Cross-Linking
- Star Wars Gallery: https://starwarsgallery.netlify.app/
- Description: Custom static image API and gallery serving high-resolution Star Wars assets mapped 1:1 to SWAPI resource endpoints.
- Integration: Star Wars App requests images directly from `https://starwarsgallery.netlify.app/assets/{resource}/{id}.jpg`.

## Routes
- `/`: Home dashboard featuring main categories.
- `/characters`: SWAPI People directory.
- `/starships`: SWAPI Starships directory.
- `/planets`: SWAPI Planets directory.
- `/vehicles`: SWAPI Vehicles directory.
- `/species`: SWAPI Species directory.
